name: Recorder
description: Record a sample from the mics, the line-in or the pads, and trim it to a loop
changelog: 0.5.0: Opened from Arrange's CLIP EDIT on an audio block, the Recorder loads that block's clip with the markers on the part of the file the block plays; ARR puts the trimmed clip back on the block's bar in place of the block it came from (one undo step), or goes back without a change.
0.4.2: focus is a white frame inside the button, not the theme's ring -- that stands 4 px out and the 22 px rows cut it to brackets
0.4.1: A value being turned reads dark on the accent: the text colour sits on the button, which is the only thing ever EDITED, not on its label
0.4.0: USB input -- what the computer plays into the board over USB audio, before the mixer's fader; says so when the board is not in its USB audio profile; requires core 1.28

0.3.0: PRE -- a bar or two of count-in before a take with the song, the beats counted down; FILES browses the whole card a folder at a time (paged); SAVE always writes into the recordings; requires core 1.27

0.2.0: SYNC -- REC plays the open song from bar FROM and the take lines up with it (frame 0 on that bar, the codecs' delay taken off), the time as bar.beat; ARRANGE puts the marked loop on a track of the song, a synced take where it was sung; requires core 1.26
